d:
Meena Kumari’s final film, Gomti Ke Kinare (1972), became an unexpected reflection of her own life. Battling liver cirrhosis, depression and financial difficulties, the Tragedy Queen continued shooting despite her deteriorating health. She even sold her bungalow to help the film’s director, Saawan Kumar, complete the project. Nargis once described the film as the story of Kumari’s own life.
